The 1–10 value is project-authored; no ranking or title outcome is used as a tuning target.

squash_tradition.rationale: ATP Earth KAZ squash_tradition estimate for 2025. Current 2026 branch, programme, court and centre counts are not backcast into this year. Tradition is supported by documented organised tennis on current Kazakhstan territory since the 1930s and international-tournament continuity since 1991. The 1–10 value is project-authored; no ranking or title outcome is used as a tuning target.

squash_popularity.rationale: ATP Earth KAZ squash_popularity estimate for 2026.
